title: What evaluations of San Francisco programmes found
question: Where a programme has been evaluated, who did it, were they independent of the operator, and what result did they state?
finding: 151 findings from 54 evaluations of 70 San Francisco programmes are on file. 58 findings come from an evaluator independent of the operator, 34 from the operator itself or someone it paid, and for 59 independence is unclear, mostly where the Controller compiles figures the departments report. Few studies have a comparison group, so most say what happened, not what the programme caused.
how: The download step read each evaluation, audit and study and wrote one row per stated result with its page, the evaluator, who paid, the study design as the document describes it, and whether the evaluator was independent of the operator, judged only from the document's own funding and acknowledgement statements. Rows are listed independent first, newest first.
limits: Each row restates one figure from a longer document and can mislead out of context; read the page. Many City figures are administrative data reported by the departments themselves. The download notes record that no evaluation could be located for the Street Violence Intervention Program, the homelessness department's Problem Solving programme, CityBuild outcomes or the guaranteed income pilot for artists, and that several results are printed only as charts.
